name: Navy
description: Members of the interstellar navy which patrols space between the stars. The navy fights pirates, smugglers, and foreign powers.

assignments.name: Line/Crew
assignments.description: You serve as a general crewmember or officer on a ship of the line.

assignments.name: Engineer/Gunner
assignments.description: You serve as an engineer or gunner on a starship.

assignments.name: Flight
assignments.description: You are a pilot of a shuttle, fighter, or other vessel.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: You join a gambling circle on board.
events.effectDescription: Roll Gambler 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: lose a Benefit roll.

effects.detail: Gambler 8+ for extra Benefit or lose Benefit

events.description: You are given a special assignment or duty.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: You are assigned to the bridge of your vessel.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Electronics (Sensors) 1, Pilot 1, or Astrogation 1.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: Your vessel participates in a notable military engagement.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Electronics 1, Engineer 1, Gunner 1 or Pilot 1.

effects.detail: Gain Electronics 1, Engineer 1, Gunner 1 or Pilot 1

events.description: You foil an attempted crime on board, such as piracy, smuggling, or sabotage.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: You serve on an older vessel and gain an appreciation for its quirks.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Mechanic 1, Vacc Suit 1, or Engineer 1.

effects.detail: Gain Mechanic 1, Vacc Suit 1 or Engineer 1

events.description: Your commanding officer takes an interest in your career.
events.effectDescription: Either gain Tactics (Naval) 1 or DM+4 to your next advancement roll (choose one).

effects.detail: Tactics (Naval) 1 or DM+4 to next advancement

events.description: You display heroism in battle, saving the entire ship.
events.effectDescription: You may gain a promotion or a commission automatically.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: Your ship is destroyed in a naval battle. Gain a Contact in a different branch of the military and Vacc Suit 1 or Athletics (Dexterity) 1.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain a Contact. Gain Vacc Suit 1 or Athletics (Dexterity) 1.

mishaps.description: During a battle, defeat or other emergency, you are forced to abandon your ship. Gain Survival 1 or Pilot 1.
You are placed in the frozen watch — Loss of a term. You are not ejected from the career.
mishaps.effectDescription: Lose a term but remain in career.

effects.detail: Frozen watch — lose term, stay in career

mishaps.description: You are tormented by or quarrel with an officer or fellow crewman. Gain that individual as a Rival as they drive you out of the service.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

benefits: Ship's Boat or Two Ship Shares
